From one fruit tree to a whole row of conifers.

From pruning a single fruit tree to felling a row of lofty conifers, Mapperley Tree Services covers all aspects of tree work, and the site is cleared afterwards.

Here is the kind of work they do, in their own photos.

Hedges and conifers

Cutting back tall conifers and hedges is a regular job for us. We treat conifers, reduce them and take the waste away.

  • Conifer reduction
  • Pruning
  • Conifer treatment

Tree removal and felling

One tree or many. Dead, leaning or overgrown trees come down in sections, the stump can go too, and more light reaches your garden.

  • Tree removal
  • Crown reduction
  • Root removal

Stumps, clearance and chipping

When the tree is down we remove the stump, grind it out, chip the branches and clear the site.

  • Stump removal
  • Site clearance
  • Wood chipping

Tree shaping

We also shape trees to improve the look of an outdoor space: grafting, creasing, bending, framing, twisting, weaving, braiding and more.

  • Grafting and bending
  • Framing and twisting
  • Weaving and braiding
